recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future changes to extension context wording should be handled under later context-specific issues such as FHIR-38630 or FHIR-46620 rather than reopening this STU3 clarification.
issue_request: FHIR-17104 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification STU3 FHIR-I issue asking for help understanding the kind, context, and type elements used when defining extensions; the accepted resolution was to add a reference to the explanation on the Defining Extensions page.
initial_application: The issue was applied by git-svn commit 895e4cc9fde65f6e87c919f3e1c4097ba309e2cd, matching the Jira svn revision 14324 comment. That commit updated the StructureDefinition introduction metadata table so extension context guidance points to defining-extensions.html.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps the extensibility pages and StructureDefinition resource in the active build. The current StructureDefinition introduction still links extension context to Defining Extensions, defining-extensions.html#context contains the explanatory table and notes, FHIR-38630 later added the same anchor directly to StructureDefinition.context, and FHIR-46620 later clarified Resource and specialization behavior in the same section.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source already satisfies the FHIR-17104 resolution. No source hunk was necessary; adding more kind/type/context prose would duplicate current guidance and exceed the accepted resolution.

related_jiras.note: Published R5 issue that made the Defining Extensions anchor more discoverable from StructureDefinition.context.
